import BoundedQueue.Spec

namespace BoundedQueue

def step : Impl := fun s op =>
  match op with
  | .enqueue x => if s.items.length < s.capacity then (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] }) else (.rejected, s)
  | .dequeue =>
    match s.items with
    | [] => (.rejected, s)
    | x :: rest => (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 })

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_capacity        : CapacityBound step := sorry
theorem req_enqueue_effects : EnqueueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_dequeue_effects : DequeueEffects step := sorry
theorem req_fifo            : Fifo step := sorry

end BoundedQueue

namespace BoundedQueue

def step : Impl := fun s op =>
  match op with
  | .enqueue x => if s.items.length < s.capacity then (.ok, { s with items := s.items ++ [x] }) else (.rejected, s)
  | .dequeue =>
    match s.items with
    | [] => (.rejected, s)
    | x :: rest => (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 })

theorem req_capacity_helper2 : CapacityBound step := by
  intro s op hle
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    by_cases h : s.items.length < s.capacity
    · simp only [step, h, ↓reduceIte]
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      omega
    · simp only [step, h, ↓reduceIte]
      exact hle
  | dequeue =>
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil =>
      have hstep : step s .dequeue = (.rejected, s) := by simp [step, hitems]
      rw [hstep]
      exact hle
    | cons x rest =>
      have hstep : step s .dequeue = (.got x, { s with items := rest, served := s.served + 1 }) := by simp [step, hitems]
      rw [hstep]
      simp only
      have hlen : s.items.length = rest.length + 1 := by rw [hitems]; simp
      omega

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s op h
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    simp [step, h]
  | dequeue =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil => simp [hitems] at h
    | cons x rest =>
      simp [step, hitems]

theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s op h
  cases op with
  | enqueue x =>
    simp [Valid] at h
    simp [step, h]
  | dequeue =>

    cases hitems : s.items with
    | nil => simp [step, hitems]
    | cons x rest =>
